note: Conditions as of the NSE close on as_of_session; foreign series use observations dated before it.

x_brent_5d_ret_pct.definition: Change in Brent spot (FRED DCOILBRENTEU) between the last observation dated before feature_window_start_session and the last observation dated before week_start
x_brent_5d_ret_pct.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start (observations dated week_start or later are excluded)

x_sp500_5d_ret_pct.definition: Change in S&P 500 (Yahoo ^GSPC) between the last observation dated before feature_window_start_session and the last observation dated before week_start
x_sp500_5d_ret_pct.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start (observations dated week_start or later are excluded)

x_usdinr_5d_ret_pct.definition: Change in USD/INR noon NY (FRED DEXINUS); + = rupee weaker between the last observation dated before feature_window_start_session and the last observation dated before week_start
x_usdinr_5d_ret_pct.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start (observations dated week_start or later are excluded)

x_gold_5d_ret_pct.definition: Change in Gold front-month future (Yahoo GC=F) between the last observation dated before feature_window_start_session and the last observation dated before week_start
x_gold_5d_ret_pct.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start (observations dated week_start or later are excluded)

x_ust10y_5d_chg_bp.definition: Change in US 10Y Treasury yield (FRED DGS10) between the last observation dated before feature_window_start_session and the last observation dated before week_start
x_ust10y_5d_chg_bp.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start (observations dated week_start or later are excluded)

x_vix_level_at_start.definition: CBOE VIX close (FRED VIXCLS) of the last US session dated before week_start
x_vix_level_at_start.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start

x_nifty_prev_20d_ret_pct.definition: NIFTY 50 return from 20 sessions before week_start to the week_start close
x_nifty_prev_20d_ret_pct.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start

x_nifty_prev_20d_vol_ann_pct.definition: Annualised SD of the 20 NIFTY 50 daily returns ending at the week_start close
x_nifty_prev_20d_vol_ann_pct.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start

x_nifty_prev_5d_ret_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_nifty_prev_10d_ret_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_nifty_prev_60d_ret_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_nifty_prev_5d_vol_ann_pct.definition: SD of last 5 daily returns x sqrt(252) x 100
x_nifty_prev_5d_vol_ann_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_nifty_prev_60d_vol_ann_pct.definition: SD of last 60 daily returns x sqrt(252) x 100
x_nifty_prev_60d_vol_ann_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_nifty_drawdown_from_60d_peak_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_nifty_max_drawdown_60d_pct.definition: min over last 60 sessions of 100*(close/running max within window - 1)
x_nifty_max_drawdown_60d_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_nifty_rebound_from_60d_trough_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_nifty_dist_ma20_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_nifty_dist_ma50_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_nifty_streak_sessions.definition: signed count of consecutive same-sign daily returns ending d0 (+up, -down)
x_nifty_streak_sessions.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_niftybank_prev_5d_ret_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_niftybank_prev_20d_ret_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_niftybank_prev_20d_vol_ann_pct.definition: SD of last 20 daily returns x sqrt(252) x 100
x_niftybank_prev_20d_vol_ann_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_niftyit_prev_20d_ret_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_niftypharma_prev_20d_ret_pct.timing: NSE close dated <= d0 (prediction time = NSE close on d0)

x_brent_20d_ret_pct.timing: observations dated < d0; window start = last obs dated < the NSE session k sessions before d0

x_brent_20d_vol_ann_pct.definition: SD of last 20 daily returns (obs dated < d0) x sqrt(252) x 100
x_brent_20d_vol_ann_pct.timing: observations dated < d0; window start = last obs dated < the NSE session k sessions before d0

x_usdinr_20d_ret_pct.definition: change between last obs < p20 and last obs < d0; + = rupee weaker
x_usdinr_20d_ret_pct.timing: observations dated < d0; window start = last obs dated < the NSE session k sessions before d0

x_usdinr_20d_vol_ann_pct.definition: SD of last 20 daily returns (obs dated < d0) x sqrt(252) x 100
x_usdinr_20d_vol_ann_pct.timing: observations dated < d0; window start = last obs dated < the NSE session k sessions before d0

x_sp500_20d_ret_pct.definition: change between last obs < p20 and last obs < d0
x_sp500_20d_ret_pct.timing: observations dated < d0; window start = last obs dated < the NSE session k sessions before d0

x_sp500_20d_vol_ann_pct.definition: SD of last 20 daily returns (obs dated < d0) x sqrt(252) x 100
x_sp500_20d_vol_ann_pct.timing: observations dated < d0; window start = last obs dated < the NSE session k sessions before d0

x_gold_20d_ret_pct.definition: change between last obs < p20 and last obs < d0
x_gold_20d_ret_pct.timing: observations dated < d0; window start = last obs dated < the NSE session k sessions before d0

x_ust10y_20d_chg_bp.timing: observations dated < d0; window start = last obs dated < the NSE session k sessions before d0

x_vix_5d_chg_pts.definition: VIX[last obs < d0] - VIX[last obs < p5]
x_vix_5d_chg_pts.timing: observations dated < d0; window start = last obs dated < the NSE session k sessions before d0

x_is_event.definition: 1 if any dataset event became public after the prediction time of feature_window_start_session and at or before this row's prediction time
x_is_event.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start; DATE_ONLY events count as public at 23:59:59 UTC of their date

x_event_geopolitical.definition: 1 if an event of class B became public in the feature window (overlapping events: flags OR-ed)
x_event_geopolitical.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start

x_event_macro_policy.definition: 1 if an event of class C became public in the feature window (overlapping events: flags OR-ed)
x_event_macro_policy.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start

x_event_financial_crisis.definition: 1 if an event of class D became public in the feature window (overlapping events: flags OR-ed)
x_event_financial_crisis.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start

x_event_commodity_supply.definition: 1 if an event of class E became public in the feature window (overlapping events: flags OR-ed)
x_event_commodity_supply.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start

x_event_other_shock.definition: 1 if an event of class F became public in the feature window (overlapping events: flags OR-ed)
x_event_other_shock.timing: prediction timestamp = NSE close 15:30 IST on week_start
